## PR description
### [Model] Add LTX-2.5 support  [labels: new model, diffusion, merge-test, diffusion-x2v-test]
- [x] Four LTX-2.5 pipeline classes with T2V and first-frame I2V.
  - [x] Offline examples and OpenAI-compatible online serving.
  - [x] Full/SFT and distilled one-/two-stage schedules, CRF-18 conditioning, x2 latent upsampling, LoRA 450 refinement, and FP32 re-noise.
  - [x] BF16 cuDNN official parity 
  - [x] HSDP2, DLO DP2, whole-model offload, and VAE slicing qualified as memory/capacity paths.
  - [ ] Native DP2 scheduling, TP2/SP2, FP8, regional compile, VAE tiling/patch parallel, and H100 FA3 validation
  - [ ] Cache-DiT, TRTLLM attention, Ring SP, and TeaCache are not supported for LTX-2.5 in this PR.
